data.title: Order to remove green waste (Ordnungsverfügung)
data.summary: The City of Musterstadt public order office (Ordnungsamt) orders you to remove green waste dumped on the city green space behind your property at Lindenweg 12 by 20 January 2026. If you don't, the city threatens substitute performance (Ersatzvornahme) at an estimated €480.00.
data.explanation: The city says green cuttings were dumped on municipal land behind your property and orders you to remove them completely by 20 January 2026. If you don't, the city may have the work done itself and bill you, with estimated costs of €480.00. You may also decide to challenge the order by court action (Klage) at the Administrative Court (Verwaltungsgericht) Musterstadt. No preliminary objection procedure applies. The app shows until when you can file. If you dispute that the waste is yours, consider getting legal advice soon.

items.title: Remove green waste
items.quote: Ich fordere Sie gemäß § 14 OBG NRW auf, die Ablagerungen bis zum 20.01.2026
items.action: Completely remove the dumped green waste from the city green space behind your property.
items.consequence: The city threatens substitute performance (Ersatzvornahme) with estimated costs of €480.00.

items.title: Deadline to file court action (Klage)

date.text: binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids

items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
items.action: If you want to challenge the order, file an action with the Administrative Court Musterstadt in writing or on record at the court registry.
items.consequence: After the deadline the order becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
